question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**sight**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the increasing visibility of overweight children.
 
• The word in the blank should describe how overweight children are frequently seen in many countries.
 
• "**Sight**" accurately fits as it refers to something that is visible or can be seen often.
 
• Other options ("**might**", "**light**", "**tight**") do not fit the context of describing an observable phenomenon.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Many parents think of overweight children as ‘cute’ and cuddly. However, obesity must not be 1.* *seen__* *as a healthy sign. 2. __**When**__ obese children grow up, they will be more prone 3. __**to**__ health problems like high blood pressure 4. __**or**__ diabetes. Today, overweight children are becoming a common 5. __**sight**__ in many countries.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Might (संभावना): "Might" expresses possibility and does not fit the context here.
 
• Light (प्रकाश): "Light" does not fit contextually as it refers to illumination.
 
• Tight (कसा हुआ): "Tight" refers to being firmly fixed and does not fit the context.
